content: We perform information extraction with regular expressions on the statistics in order to structure the game into a chronological sequence of events, which can then be aligned with the corresponding text spans from the news article, as well as used as input in the text generation. An initial sequence of events after information extraction is shown on the left side in Figure FIGREF5. Before text generation, these events are yet enhanced with additional information derived from the event itself, or the game.
